docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-06-2008 - JUDGMENT. (CLERK-BETH WILBER, 506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF COMMINS & WEBSTER, P.C. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT 12K HOLDINGS, INC. $3,707.12 PRINCIPAL, $61.78 INTEREST, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,818.90 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-06-2008 - JUDGMENT. (CLERK-BETH WILBER, 506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT CROSS COMPLAINANT 12K HOLDINGS, INC. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY CROSS DEFENDANT COMMINS & WEBSTER, P.C. PLAINTIFF'S HAVE SHOWN BY PREPONDERANCE OF EVIDENCE THAT THEY ARE OWED $37O7.12. DEFENDANT'S CLAIM FAILS DUE TO LACK OF A WRITTEN CONTRACT SHOWING FURTHER REDUCTIONS ON BILLINGS WERE REQUIRED.
